body:
## Result

Wood touching wheat in any of eight neighboring tiles now gets marked for clearing, including inside Nicowar's wood-farming zone. The farming scan releases non-wood clearing tiles there too, allowing replacement wheat to regain protection; building clearance is retained. The existing blanket clearing policy for wood at water-gradient distances 6–9 remains.

This intentionally gives wheat priority over nearby wood reserves and can increase clearing work. No new AI state, save fields, settings, order executors or replay/network gates. Existing clearing marks on wood persist until the wood is gone. As with the existing cleanup outside the wood zone, non-wood marks from other sources on shared teams can now be released inside it.

## Validation

macOS arm64 release client and harness built successfully. The existing CI-registered harness now covers all eight directions, wrapped corners, wood-zone precedence, unaffected wood away from wheat, and replacement-wheat protection.

Captured regression output (each new expectation failed before its production change):

```text
FAIL: wheat adjacency overrides wood zone
FAIL: eight-way wheat adjacency
PASS: Nicowar zone boundaries, eight-way adjacency, wrap seams, discovery, protection, cleanup and building clearance
PASS: disposable profile preferences unchanged
```

Commands:

```sh
scons -j4 release=1 server=0 build/src/glob2 nicowar-farming-test
python3 test/run-savegame-safety-tests.py --check-preferences build/src/NicowarFarmingHarness .
```

The installed macOS playtest app completed SmallForTwo, seed 42, Nicowar/Nicowar, 4096 ticks. Local replay/checksum/save artifacts are in `/tmp/nicowar-diagonal-smoke`; these are not remotely attached evidence. The harness verifies area orders, not complete farm reclamation. Cross-platform checksum equivalence and save/resume equivalence were not tested for this follow-up.

## Approval

The human maintainer explicitly requested retaining the distance-band policy and committing and merging the wheat-priority, diagonal-adjacency and cleanup changes after reviewing the behavior in this session.
title: Prioritize Nicowar wheat over adjacent wood in all eight directions
